item.title: Mount Wakakusa: The Grassy Hill Above Nara — Guide
item.description: Mount Wakakusa (Wakakusayama) is the smooth, grassy hill that rises directly behind Nara Park’s temples, its bare turf standing out against the wooded slopes around it. A gentle climb up its open grassland — where deer graze freely — leads in about 30–40 minutes to a summit with one of the finest panoramas in the region, taking in Todaiji, Kofukuji’s pagoda, the whole city of Nara and the mountains beyond, especially magical at sunset.
